battery.name: static_objects_v1
battery.description: 24 static-object prompts, 8 categories × 3 tiers (easy / medium / hard). Every prompt carries must_have items the planner turns into acceptance checks. Same battery runs under any generator; keep the judge model fixed across arms.

prompts.prompt: a simple three-legged round wooden stool, 45 cm tall
must_have: three splayed legs of equal length

prompts.prompt: a mid-century wooden dining chair with a slatted backrest and tapered legs
must_have: backrest with at least three vertical slats
back legs continue into back posts

prompts.prompt: a writing desk with two pedestals of three drawers each, a central knee-hole, a leather inlay top and brass drawer pulls
must_have: three drawers per pedestal with visible fronts

prompts.prompt: a chunky toy car with a rounded body and four thick wheels
a pickup truck with a two-door cab, open cargo bed, wheel arches and side mirrors
a farm tractor with large rear tyres with treads, small front wheels, an exposed engine block, exhaust stack, driver seat, steering wheel and a roll bar
must_have: rear wheels much larger than front wheels

prompts.prompt: a claw hammer with a wooden handle and a steel head
must_have: steel head with a flat face

prompts.prompt: a cordless power drill with a pistol grip, trigger, battery pack in the base of the grip and a keyless chuck holding a drill bit
a cast-iron bench vise with fixed and sliding jaws, a lead screw with a tommy bar handle, guide rails, a small anvil face and mounting base with bolt holes
must_have: two jaws with a visible gap
lead screw with sliding T handle

prompts.prompt: an electric kettle with a spout, a lid and a side handle on a round base
a two-slot retro toaster with rounded chrome body, a lever on the side, a browning dial and a crumb tray
an espresso machine with a group head and portafilter, a steam wand, a drip tray with grate, a water tank at the back, and a top-mounted cup warmer with a pressure gauge on the front panel
must_have: portafilter with handle under a group head

prompts.prompt: a potted barrel cactus in a terracotta pot with soil
a small potted palm with a textured trunk and eight arching fronds made of many leaflets
a bonsai tree with a twisted thick trunk, three layered foliage pads, exposed roots over a rock and a shallow oval ceramic tray with moss
must_have: at least three distinct foliage pads

prompts.prompt: a small garden shed with a pitched roof, one door and one window
a tapered lighthouse with red and white bands, a gallery with railing, a glass lantern room and a domed cap, on a rocky base
a Dutch windmill with an octagonal tapered body, thatched cap, four lattice sails, a balcony stage with railing, a door, and two shuttered windows
must_have: four lattice sails in a cross

prompts.prompt: a stack of five alphabet blocks of decreasing size in a slightly twisted tower
a wooden rocking horse with curved rockers, a saddle, handles and a mane
must_have: horse body with head and four legs

prompts.prompt: a toy steam locomotive with a boiler, smokestack, cab with windows, cowcatcher, six driving wheels with connecting rods, and a coal tender with four wheels
must_have: separate tender with coal load and four wheels

prompts.prompt: a snare drum with tension rods and two drumsticks resting on top
must_have: at least eight tension rods around the rim

prompts.prompt: an acoustic guitar with a figure-eight body, sound hole, bridge, fretted neck, headstock with six tuning pegs and six strings
a five-piece drum kit with a bass drum with pedal, snare on a stand, two rack toms, a floor tom, a hi-hat and two cymbals on stands, and a throne
